status: development design after inspected v1-v12 and outcome-blind information-source feasibility audit; not preregistration or independent confirmation
anchor: Fixed disclosed v11/v12 assignment: T for Binder/Wielek, original uHNDI for Mendeley; no improvement attributed to this prior assignment.

binder.features: At each fixed lag: matched trajectory versus +/-10Hz contemporaneous off-trajectory contrast; matched versus time-reversed trajectory contrast; matched mean ITPC. opt5 linear55->25Hz/0.5s; opt2 log100->30Hz/1s. Uniform frequency-bin average over stated range, eight actual common channels. opt5 two views always present; opt2 two views absent for7 retained patients (NaN, no removal).
binder.limit: Opt5 matched trajectory was studied in v1; only off-trajectory/reversed references and optional second-stimulus view add information here. Aggregate500ms-window ITPC, not raw voltage or single trials; lag0.1 does not establish physiological latency resolution.

wielek.features: At each lag, joint automatic-stage contingency with every intervening edge valid: mutual information divided by sqrt(left/right entropy); antisymmetric excess dependence total variation; signed N1->N2 observed/independent contrast; largest singular value of marginal-whitened excess dependence. No fabricated N1 events when absent. No raw EEG/manual/eye/clinical metadata.
wielek.boundary: Every intervening epoch must be consecutive and in same time_record; do not connect gaps merely because endpoints match.

mendeley.features: Patient-local channelwise midranks of clean chronological theta/alpha powers. At each lag with all intervening blocks clean, centered cosine cross-band6x6 matrix: mean diagonal, mean off-diagonal, largest singular/6 after rowwise spatial common-mode removal, and Frobenius antisymmetry/12. Marginal rank ties/constant channels map to zero correlation where norm0. Preserve original41patients and6channels.
mendeley.limit: Coupling of block powers, not phase coupling, directed connectivity or single-trial response. Raw preprocessing/QC frozen to v11 cache; finite-window sample correlation not independent-sample significance.

algorithm: Observed-support-aware sparse strong-anchor correction. For each feature fit robust location/scale and baseline projection only on training patients observing that feature; absent transformed feature=0. On each step learn gradient direction and deletion sensitivity only from observed positive-negative patient pairs for that feature. Select largest abs(gradient)-sensitivity, optimize signed scalar all-pair log loss on that observed subset, at most2distinctfeatures, total L1 coefficient budget<=eta. No unobserved test signal is fabricated.
sensitivity: Delete-patient pair-averaging gradients hold training representation and current scores fixed. Penalty is a heuristic sensitivity measure, not full-refit jackknife, confidence interval or significance test. Features require at least2observed training patients of each class.
controls: without_optional removes Binder opt2 and is identical elsewhere; old_information uses full frozen v12 extra matrix with the new learner, a declared input ablation; median_imputed fills train feature medians then uses v12 StablePairIncrement; correction_only omits output anchor but uses baseline-conditioned representation; mask_anchor_control LR receives T/uHNDI plus per-feature availability bits, no signal extras. Same-input classics get T/uHNDI plus exactly all new feature values, training-only median imputation with all-empty-column0 and no explicit masks.
selection: Seven configs for primary and sparse ablations, identical across cohorts; mean3-inner-fold AUC, ties1e-12 prefer eta0, smallereta, fewersteps. Same fixed3C/classicRFgrids asv11/v12. No test-label orientation or exclusion.
inner_seed_rule: outerseed+10000+outerfold; exactly original patients and v12split roles
metric: Arithmetic mean outer-fold AUC, then five-seed mean and equal-cohort macro; retain all methods/seeds/negative results.
performance_target: Positive macro deltas vs T and originaluHNDI at everyseed and positive5-seed cohortmean vsboth in eachcohort. Positive macro mean vs measurement_anchor, old_information_increment and mask_anchor_control. Same-input recent journal comparison required before superiority claim; v10journalinputs differ.
novelty_limit: Candidate combination of observed-support ranking correction and targeted joint-view contrasts; no constituent priority, guaranteedgain, rawgaininvariance, mechanism or clinical superiority claim. Previous cohorts repeatedly inspected; independent validation still required.
protection: Freeze protocol/code before outer predictions; byte-protect all oldresults/manuscripts, v11rawcache and v13sourceaudit; no outcome-informed rewrite of completed experiment.
